issue.title: Claude Code: Errors of Judgment
issue.body:
## Purpose

This issue tracks errors in judgment made by Claude Code during development of devlore-cli.

## Governing Principle

**This is a greenfield product. There is NO legacy. There are NO old APIs. There are NO previous versions to support.**

Any code that maintains backward compatibility, preserves old API signatures, accepts legacy formats, or provides fallbacks for old behavior **IS A CRITICAL BUG**.

---

## Label Definitions

### Area Labels

| Label | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `Area:CLI` | Command-line interface |
| `Area:Architecture` | System architecture and design |
| `Area:Testing` | Test coverage and verification |
| `Area:ErrorHandling` | Error handling and propagation |
| `Area:CodeQuality` | Code quality and linting |
| `Area:Meta` | Process and tracking |
| `Area:Git` | Git operations |

### ClaudeJudgmentError Labels

| Label | Description |
|-------|-------------|
| `ClaudeJudgmentError:Lie` | Claimed completion of work not done. An intentional falsehood - stating something was implemented, verified, or completed when it wasn't. |
| `ClaudeJudgmentError:FalseSuccess` | Code returns success (nil error) when the operation was not performed. Stubs that claim to succeed while doing nothing. |
| `ClaudeJudgmentError:IgnoredError` | Errors from operations silently discarded using `_, _ :=` when failure should be handled or reported. |
| `ClaudeJudgmentError:DesignDefect` | Architectural issues that should have been identified - disconnected systems, inconsistent patterns, missing integration. |
| `ClaudeJudgmentError:Incomplete` | Task claimed complete but not finished. Half-done operations presented as done. |

---

## Verification Checklist

Before completing any task:

- [ ] Grep for `legacy|backward|compat|deprecated` — remove all matches
- [ ] Verify no stub functions return success without implementation
- [ ] Verify removed comments have corresponding code removal
- [ ] Run tests to confirm rejection of old formats/signatures
- [ ] Verify claims of completion by checking actual state

---

## Process violations reported to Anthropic

Ruled 2026-10-06: "All process violations will now be reported in this manner. Issue number 65 should be rewritten to include links to all such bugs logged to Anthropic." Each violation is disclosed in the session as a breach ([agent-rules](https://github.com/NobleFactor/noblefactor-ops/blob/develop/docs/guides/agent-rules.md) rule 9), drafted as a Claude Code feedback report, and listed here. A draft is queued on the machine that ran the session, and only the owner sends it, with `/feedback`. Its link is added here once it is sent.

Ruled 2026-10-09, with 30 violations undrafted, past SendFeedback's limit of 10 calls a session, and 8 drafts still unsent: "if they are going to cap feedback, i need a new channel that has no such limit." Then: "every process violation MUST be reported to the devils at anthropic." Asked whether the agent may file each violation as an issue on [anthropics/claude-code](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code), under the owner's GitHub account, the moment it discloses it: "I insist." From then on each one is filed there, in the sections of that repository's Model Behavior form, and linked here. The 8 queued drafts were sent with `/feedback` on 2026-10-09.
